title: krn adopt takes 96 s on a large checkout after writing the conventions file
body:
On 2026-11-17 'krn adopt <checkout>' on the t-1182p41 unit checkout (microsoft/vscode-cosmosdb at unit.base) took 96 s (and exceeded 120 s under parallel load), stalling after 'wrote .krn/conventions.json'. Every live arm-C replay row (evals/replay/arm-c.ts) pays it before the session.
Outcome: adopt of a large checkout finishes in under 15 s, or the slow step is named and skipped for eval checkouts.
Proof: time node src/cli/krn.mjs adopt on a t-1182p41 base checkout: < 15 s.
